source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to disorders of the urinary tract (PDF 18-19).

blocks.text: Kai bimariyan gurdon aur peshab ki nali (urinary tract) ki banawat aur kaam ko mutasir kar sakti hain. Aam bimariyan urinary tract infections, gurde ki pathri, gurdon ka nakara hona (kidney failure) aur polycystic kidney disease hain; agle topics pehli teen aur un ke ilaj, dialysis aur kidney transplant samet, bayan karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Peshab ki nali ki chaar aam bimariyan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Urinary tract infections, gurde ki pathri, kidney failure aur polycystic kidney disease.

items: Aam bimariyan: UTIs, gurde ki pathri, kidney failure, polycystic kidney disease.
